welcome.title: Welcome to Unwired Mail
welcome.description: Create your Product Account with Apple or Google, then choose the mailbox to connect.

revoked.title: This device was removed
revoked.description: One of your trusted devices removed this one from your Product Account, so its account data, keys and mailbox access were deleted from this device. Anything copied from it before then cannot be erased remotely. Your mail in Gmail is not affected.

deleted.title: Product Account deleted
deleted.description: This Product Account was permanently deleted, so its account data, keys and mailbox access were removed from this device. Anything copied from another device while it was offline cannot be erased remotely. Your mail in Gmail is not affected.

locked.title: Unlock your device

accountRemoval.title: This device and your account
accountRemoval.signOutConfirm: Signing out removes this device from your Product Account and deletes its account data, keys and mailbox access from this device. Save and confirm any Recovery Key shown first. Your other devices and your mail in Gmail are not affected. To use this device again, sign in and approve it from a trusted device or with your Recovery Key.
accountRemoval.deleteConfirm: Deleting your Product Account permanently removes it, its private data and its sign-ins from Unwired Mail. Other devices remove their local data when they reconnect; copies on offline or compromised devices cannot be erased remotely. It cannot be undone. Your mail stays in Gmail, and authorization you gave Google is not revoked. You sign in again to confirm.
accountRemoval.sign-out: Sign-out could not be confirmed. Retry sign-out when you are online to finish removing this device and its local account data. Save and confirm any Recovery Key shown before signing out.
accountRemoval.deletion-refused: Your Product Account was not deleted, and nothing was removed. Try again and sign in with the Apple or Google account that opens it.
accountRemoval.deletion: Deletion could not be confirmed. Your Product Account may already be deleted. Retry deletion when you are online to confirm it and finish removing local account data.

setup-pending.title: Private sync
setup-pending.description: Private sync setup has not finished. It continues the next time your Product Account is verified. Sign in again to finish it now.

recovery-key.title: Save your Recovery Key
recovery-key.description: Your product data is end-to-end encrypted. If you lose every trusted device, this Recovery Key is the only way to unlock it. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe. Unwired Mail cannot show it to anyone else or reset it.

ready.title: Private sync is on
ready.description: Your product data is end-to-end encrypted. Only your trusted devices can read it.

enrollment-needed.title: Unlock private data on this device

enrollment-pending.title: Approve this device

revocation.title: Trusted devices
revocation.description: These other devices can read your private data. Remove one you no longer use, or one that was lost or stolen.
revocation.confirm: Removing {{name}} blocks it from your Product Account, push notifications and private sync, and your other devices switch to new keys. You sign in again, then save and confirm a new Recovery Key; only then is {{name}} removed, and your previous Recovery Key stops opening new private data at once. It deletes its account data the next time it connects, but anything it already holds while offline or compromised cannot be erased remotely.
revocation.proposal: Save a new Recovery Key to remove {{name}}
revocation.prompt: Write down this new Recovery Key and keep it safe. To confirm you saved it, enter its last four characters. {{name}} is removed only then, and your previous Recovery Key stops opening new private data.
revocation.label: Last four characters of the new Recovery Key
revocation.mismatch: That does not match the end of the new Recovery Key. Check your written copy and try again.
revocation.removed: The device was removed. The new Recovery Key you confirmed is now your Recovery Key; your previous one no longer opens new private data.
revocation.renewed: Your Product Account changed before the removal finished, so nothing was removed. Save the new Recovery Key shown now and confirm it again; the key shown before will not work.
revocation.unconfirmed: The removal could not be confirmed. Keep the new Recovery Key shown here, and confirm again when you are online to finish.
revocation.superseded: The selected device was removed. The Recovery Key prepared here is not your current Recovery Key; keep the Recovery Key confirmed for the latest removal.
revocation.failed: The device could not be removed. Try again.

filing.authorization: Sent. Enter this mailbox's password again in Settings to save its copy to Sent.
filing.sent-folder: Sent. Waiting for one Sent folder to be identified before saving its copy.

unknown.unconfirmed: Gmail did not confirm this message. Check Sent in Gmail.
unknown.unconfirmed_imap: Your Sent folder did not confirm this message. Check it on the mail server.
unknown.unconfirmed_microsoft: Microsoft did not confirm this message yet. Check Sent Items in Outlook.
unknown.unconfirmed_unlisted: This message could not be confirmed. Check the Sent folder of the mailbox it was sent from.
unknown.confirming: Gmail may already have sent this message. Edit it only if it is not in Sent in Gmail.
unknown.confirming_imap: The mail server may already have sent this message. Edit it only if it is not in your Sent folder.
unknown.confirming_microsoft: Microsoft may already have sent this message. Edit it only if it is not in Sent Items in Outlook.
unknown.confirming_unlisted: This message may already have been sent. Edit it only if it is not in the Sent folder of the mailbox it was sent from.

queued.offline: Waiting to send. It sends when this device can reach Gmail and your Unwired Mail account.
queued.offline_imap: Waiting to send. It sends when this device can reach the mail server and your Unwired Mail account.
queued.offline_microsoft: Waiting to send. It sends when this device can reach Microsoft and your Unwired Mail account.
queued.offline_unlisted: Waiting to send. It sends when this device can reach its mail provider and your Unwired Mail account.
queued.locked: Waiting to send while private storage is locked. Unlock your device.
queued.rate-limited: Waiting to send. Gmail asked to wait before sending more.
queued.rate-limited_microsoft: Waiting to send. Microsoft asked to wait before sending more.
queued.rate-limited_unlisted: Waiting to send. Its mail provider asked to wait before sending more.

failed.claimed: Not sent. Another of your devices claimed this message to send it.
failed.authorization: Not sent. This mailbox needs Gmail access again.
failed.authorization_imap: Not sent. The mail server did not accept this mailbox's password. Enter it again in Settings.
failed.authorization_microsoft: Not sent. This mailbox needs Microsoft access again.
failed.authorization_unlisted: Not sent. Its mailbox needs access again.
failed.mailbox: Not sent. This mailbox is no longer connected.
failed.assets: Not sent. Its files are no longer on this device.
failed.too-large: Not sent. It is too large for Gmail.
failed.too-large_imap: Not sent. It is too large for the mail server.
failed.too-large_microsoft: Not sent. It is too large for Microsoft.
failed.too-large_unlisted: Not sent. It is too large for its mail provider.
failed.refused: Not sent. Gmail refused this message.
failed.refused_imap: Not sent. The mail server refused this message.
failed.refused_microsoft: Not sent. Microsoft refused this message.
failed.refused_unlisted: Not sent. Its mail provider refused this message.
failed.sent-folder: Not sent. Unwired Mail cannot identify one Sent folder for this mailbox's copy.

imap.title: Connect a mailbox with IMAP
imap.description: Mail is read with IMAP and sent with SMTP.
imap.appPassword: {{provider}} requires an app-specific password, which you create in your account's security settings. Your usual password does not work.
imap.smtpUsername: SMTP user name, same as incoming if blank
imap.smtpPassword: SMTP password, same as incoming if blank
imap.review: Unwired Mail connects to {{host}} on port {{port}} using TLS and checks that its certificate is valid. Your password stays on this device and is never sent to Unwired Mail.

sendingReview.tls: Mail is sent through {{host}} on port {{port}} using SSL/TLS, and its certificate is checked too.
sendingReview.starttls: Mail is sent through {{host}} on port {{port}}, which must switch to TLS with STARTTLS before any password is sent. Its certificate is checked too.

imap.incomplete: Enter the email address, password, both servers, and ports between 1 and 65535.

failure.imap-refused: The mail server did not accept that user name and password. Nothing was changed.
failure.imap-insecure: The mail server did not offer a verified secure connection, so your password was not sent. Nothing was changed.
failure.smtp-refused: The outgoing mail server did not accept that user name and password. Nothing was changed.
failure.smtp-insecure: The outgoing mail server did not offer a verified secure connection, so your password was not sent. Nothing was changed.
failure.failed: The mail server could not be reached. Nothing was changed. Check the server name and port, or try again when you are online.

imap.foldersUnavailable: Folders could not be listed. Try again when the mail server can be reached.

imapSync.authentication: The mail server needs your password again to show new mail.
imapSync.retry: The mail server could not be reached. Showing mail saved on this device.
